title: Unit Event — Cast a Spell on You

meta.Outline: Having held their real-life event, Shizuku and the others feel that their bond with their fans has grown even stronger. While exploring ideas with their fans, one of them suggests making MORE MORE JUMP! stage outfits as their next endeavor!

rows.Line: song00004_off_f
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Let's Pick the Best Outfit for Haruka!! Part 2!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Pick an outfit for Haruka?!
Here's what this contest entails!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll each be picking out clothes that we think would look good on Haruka and pitching our ideas to you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The outfit that you wish to see Haruka “wear the most” will then be worn by her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. She'll only be trying on the top outfit, so our presentations are gonna be key!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just to recap, Minori won the inaugural title with her pretty daring penguin outfit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm going to defend my title!!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Minori!>
<I can't wait to see what you come up with.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, you're supposed to be challenging her, not working together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In any case, it's always fun to pick out clothes like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially when you find exactly what you're looking for while browsing through a store. It's such a wonderful feeling...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it feels even better when your outfit is actually able to bring out someone's charm.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, the joy of picking out clothes for another person... When you put it that way, I guess it is pretty fun seeing which outfits work best with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I enjoy having outfits picked out for me like this, but I'd like to do the same for everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see what clothes you choose, Haruka!>
<I totally get how you feel, Haruka!>
<You guys should pick outfits for each other!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <What if the winner becomes the next person you pick outfits for?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like it too. We can choose outfits for whoever wins this time around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too...!
I'd love to see the outfits you put together for me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yes! They liked it!>
<I wanna see all of you do this!>
<While you're at it, why not do a mock fashion show?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all for your wonderful ideas! We'll do our best to make that fashion show a reality.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get started with our little contest! Today's theme will be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And so, the winner of “Let's Pick the Best Outfit for Haruka!! Part 2!” is...
Minori!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The crisp, blue dress and knitted cardigan you picked were very cute together.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it was really cute.>
<Haruka's so divine in girly clothes...>
<The champ, hands down.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Congratulations, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're way too good at this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She must be able to pick out the perfect clothes for Haruka because she understands her so well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. To be honest, I'm just choosing clothes that make me think, “I want Haruka to wear this!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you are a Haruka fanatic at your core. No wonder we're having so much trouble beating you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Leave everything about Haruka to me!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm a huge Haruka fan too but she's so strong...!>
<I can't wait to see what everyone picks for Minori.>
<I wonder what kind of outfit will Haruka come up with?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be sure to find an outfit that suits Minori really well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had so much fun during our stream today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone else seemed to really like it too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Based on what I've been seeing, I think our fans have been showing so much enthusiasm because of the event we put on the other day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. They're even willing to toss stream ideas our way and directly tell us what they want to see us do, which has been huge.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially since we wouldn't have been able to put on that event without their help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Idols need the support of their fans to grow and improve...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel like we in particular have been able to move forward this far because of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Definitely. I mean, we can't have them carry all the weight for us or anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But at least for the moment, growing alongside our fans seems like the best way for us to go as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And as we grow, I'd like it if we could keep spreading and inspiring hope in all of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That means we'll need to do more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start laying the groundwork for our next event while brainstorming what to do for our next stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, something that's fun and lets us interact with our fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we do another request stream? It's been a while since our last one and it'll give us a chance to ask everyone what they think!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By doing so, I'm sure we'll be able to do lots and lots more fun stuff with them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That sounds lovely. They may even come up with ideas that we'd never think of.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True. Even just the comments we received during our outfit competition really broadened the scope of our original idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The one about doing a fashion show stuck out to me the most. After we present enough outfits through our streams, we could conceivably find a venue and turn it into a real-life event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Like a real fashion show?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's not impossible.
After all, Minori, aren't you the one who said working with our fans can make these kinds of things possible?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm for this as well.
I hope we receive some wonderful suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same, so let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna try writing the script for our announcements for once since you're always writing them for us, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. Why don't we work on it together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll begin working on the script for something else. One of the segments we've turned into a series might be a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind lending me a hand, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We're all so motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'd like to do everything I can as well to make sure our fans get the most enjoyment out of what we do...!)
song00004_off_f
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
We want you to tell us what kinds of segments you want to see us do. Any ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please feel free to write as many as you like.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A cooking stream!>
<A room tour!>
<Another joint stream!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I like this one.
Airi's a wonderful cook, so I'd love to learn more from her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A room tour...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that includes you too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Any other ideas out there?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I really want to see another show!>
<Me too! Online and in person!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm definitely going to the next one!>
<Putting an event together was so much fun!>
<I wanna try helping out!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You were staff last time?!>
<Jealous!>
<I wish I could've gone. It looked like a lot of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
We're hoping to put on another event sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, but we have quite a lot to prepare in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <What if we came up with stage outfits for you?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You were in t-shirts last time.>
<I'm good at making dresses, so I'd love to help!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Our very own stage outfits...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be nice to have actual stage outfits if we plan on doing more events and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We have everyone here to thank for getting our last event off the ground as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start working on our stage outfits next time?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Based on the comments we've received so far, it seems like some people here have dressmaking experience. What sort of design do you think would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, since we're here, we could ask our fans for their thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see what MMJ comes up with!>
<Whoa! Stage outfits made by idols for idols!>
<Why not have a design competition?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, a design competition sounds like a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could each come up with a design for our stage outfits and have our fans vote for their favorite one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<We get to decide?!>
<I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'll make them after you guys pick a design!>
<I'm gonna make them with the other MMJ fans from my class!>
<I wanna make costumes with other fans too!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh... Thank you all so much!
We'll be counting on you when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
We're gonna come up with some amazing designs, so be sure to stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes, let's!
bgm_area00002
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you're all coming up with designs for stage outfits?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna come up with the designs and our fans are gonna help us actually make them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's so wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for your fans. It's not every day that you get to make stage outfits for a group of idols.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But designing these kinds of outfits sounds really hard... Do you guys already know what you're gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Not me...
My plan's to gradually work out my final idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same.
Meanwhile, Minori already has a few ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. They're just a few outfits that I always wanted to wear if I ever did become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not sure if they'll work for MORE MORE JUMP!, but my hope is that we can use them for reference!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, you're so imaginative.
I wonder which design I should go with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing your final designs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
We should do a show once your outfits are done too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Slow down. They don't even have a design picked out yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I'm just so excited...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel, Rin.
I too can't wait to see how their outfits turn out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mind showing us once they're done, girls?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it's going to take a little while...
But I really want you to see them as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means we'll need to come up with something really good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Let's get started on our designs when we get home. Sound good?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What sort of design would be good for our outfits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was still in Cheerful * Days, they made us outfits to go with each song, so we never really stuck with one design.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But getting to stand on stage while wearing a dazzling outfit was such an incredible feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, why don't I take a look at how the outfits for other idols have been designed?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... I can search for images of idol groups...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: According to Airi, all I have to do is type that in here and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh no!
I can't go back to the previous page.
What am I supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, dinner's...
Uh... What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was just looking up some images of other idol groups and so many results came up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm stuck and don't know what to do. Would you mind helping...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can I see your phone?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But why are you looking up images of other idol groups? Is it for your next stream?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
It just so happens...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you're really designing your stage outfits...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We're thinking about having our fans help actually make them, so I want them to suit MORE MORE JUMP! well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I've never designed anything like this before, so I decided to see what other idol groups wear.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you got stuck trying to open this page.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nonetheless, I still plan on doing my best to come up with as wonderful a design as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially since these outfits are going to be made just for MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For everyone's sake, I have to put my best foot forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For everyone's sake, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, anyway...
I think what you're doing is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you already know, but we've recently been trying to write our own songs as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the ones you performed during your show? I loved them so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki wrote the music for them, and she said the same thing. About them being “for us”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For all of you...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We were so happy and became so motivated... It really felt like Leo/need's meant to play the music she wrote...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which leads me to believe...
As long as you keep “everyone” in your thoughts, whatever you design is going to be truly special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, you'll have to actually design the darn thing first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. But you've given me the motivation to keep going. Thank you so much, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I doubt I said anything that profound...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I do know that it's not easy making something from complete scratch...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though I don't know much about idols and stuff, I'd like to help in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you have trouble looking things up or something, just let me know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Shizuku!
Don't just throw yourself at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't help it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Anyway, is there anything else you need help with?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
Along with seeing what other idol groups wear, I'd like to see how they look while they're dancing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'll try looking for some videos.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which group do you want to start with, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! How about...?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Are your designs ready?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not quite... I managed to come up with a few ideas, but nothing solid yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same.
I used my old QT outfit and what other idols wear as reference to come up with some rough sketches.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, I wanna see what you came up with!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't mind, but again, they're rough sketches, so try not to be disappointed, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Here. They should be in this sketchbook.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This looks so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...!
The frills on it even look like a heart.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right! This one's heart-themed!
But that's not all. Notice anything else?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it supposed to do something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Dancing's a big part of being an idol, right? So, I tried making it so these look good while we do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, the hearts on the skirt should really draw everyone's eyes when we jump...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And whenever we spin or turn, they'll bloom open like flowers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...!
On top of being cute, they do all these cool tricks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Airi, these already seem incredible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, they still need a lot of work and I plan on making them even better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mind showing me what you've all come up with?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, here are my ideas!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Lemme see...
Hey, this one's flower themed! It looks adorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's one of the outfits I've always wanted to wear if I ever did become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... In a way, this is a representation of your hopes and dreams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I have other outfits that I really want to see you three wear too, Haruka, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, found it!
They're really designed just for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they look pretty different from each other. Won't we look a little weird when we're all together on stage?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I need to think more about us as MORE MORE JUMP! when I'm designing these, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's the hard part.
I've come up with some ideas too, but nothing that really satisfies me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, I wanna see your ideas...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. Here.
I'm thinking about redrawing them, so I doubt they'll be of much help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!
This is so cute! Snazzy too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, these seem easy to move around in, like when we're doing tough dance sequences and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually had sort of the same idea as you in terms of having an outfit that can handle any dance routine, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An outfit that's suited for anything from ballads to high-tempo songs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means you put quite a lot of thought into this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you can tell Haruka came up with this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time... We'd be sacrificing some of our identity for mobility...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's the thing.
I need to find a way to work in our colors more to give them that MORE MORE JUMP! feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Our identity...
Hmm... That's so hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I'm really impressed by how you've all come up with such intricate designs in such a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi's outfit does all these neat tricks, Minori's is absolutely adorable and Haruka's gives us the freedom to dance to any song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You three have come up with some wonderful designs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Shizuku, how about your design?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me? Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I don't have anything yet. I'm still not sure which design would be best for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been looking at some of the outfits other idols wear, but trying to find something that works for us made me even more lost...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That's okay. We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
She's right!
Let's just take it one step at a time until we have to present everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're still in the middle of figuring out our own designs, so I'm sure you'll think of something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Based on what we all showed each other today, we're clearly looking at this from very different angles.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no right answer, so I say take as many liberties as you like when coming up with a design.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By doing so, I'm sure you'll be able to come up with the outfit you really want to design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The outfit I really want to design...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see. Thank you for your input.
I'll give it another try later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great, and good luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to start over from scratch too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's both keep trying our best, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We need to design the best outfits ever since our fans are gonna be making them!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, this doesn't seem right either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've drawn a few already since coming home, but none of these seem to fit the bill...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no right answer, so I say take as many liberties as you like when coming up with a design.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By doing so, I'm sure you'll be able to come up with the outfit you really want to design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What sort of outfit do I want to design?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Line:
<I wanna see Haruka in her uniform...!>
<It'll be a great representation of moving forward as a unit!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all see it that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I like your design as well, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. But I'm not letting either of you walk away with this! Here's my design!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa! This screams, Airi!>
<The skirt looks different than normal.>
<Are these all hearts that I'm seeing?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. The theme for mine is “hearts”!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want our thoughts and feelings to reach all of you as we sing and dance, so this skirt's made to turn into a heart whenever we jump, spin or turn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It looks even better than what you had before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! But to be fair, this is just what I want it to do. I don't actually know if turning all these frills into hearts is physically possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's still an amazing concept.
I'd love to wear this outfit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd look so good on you, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, last but not least... Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
Here's my design.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's not just one design!
Is there something for each of us...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They all seem to have the same theme, but they each look different in their own way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What theme did you choose, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the theme I chose is “magic”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Magic...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is, I had no confidence in myself when I first debuted as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It always took me longer than everyone else to learn a new song or dance, and I was constantly worried about making mistakes during a show...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I remembered how this one outfit I wore had this ability to turn me into someone else...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd go from Shizuku Hinomori, plain and simple, to Shizuku Hinomori the idol. I'd become someone who could actually spread hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the outfit I'm talking about was imbued with a spell that let me shine on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I wanted to come up with an outfit that could cast the same spell on MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That's so thoughtful of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Having a spell cast on us sounds so fantastic...! I'm getting excited just thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what kind of spell or magic?
It's clear that each of these are slightly different, but is there something more to them?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's start with Minori's outfit. I chose a fluffy skirt with wings on it to make sure she can go as high as she wants whenever she jumps.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka's is designed so that she can keep shining like an idol and the bijou is supposed to signify that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi is at her best whenever she's smiling, so I decided to include flowery lace and ribbon patterns to make sure her smile never fades.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: On top of all that, I want to cast a spell on each of our fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My hope is that seeing us sing and dance will put a smile on all of their faces as we try to inspire hope in them. The clovers on each of your outfits represent that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But again, I'm not too confident in my designs, so I can't say for sure if our spell will work...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You thought about us too?>
<I wanna see MMJ in these.>
<I really love this design.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
I appreciate all your kind words, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like this design a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But these are for us... Where's yours, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't get a chance to finish my own. I couldn't quite figure out what kind of spell to cast on myself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what if we thought about that together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, let's do it!>
<Hey, nice idea.>
<I want to try casting a spell on you too, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'll be a matter of figuring out how we want you to shine on stage based on the concept you came up with for these outfits, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Shizuku's never not pretty.>
<She's gonna shine even more...?!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I really admire how hard she works.>
<Me too. She's a beauty on stage but has to work really hard to be that way.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <It'd be great if your outfit could let you shine more and more as a reward for having such a great work ethic.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What about crystals as a motif?>
<I'd shed tears of joy if I saw you wear those on stage.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. They care about you just that much, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She's right.
They've come up with some wonderful ideas.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! When someone puts a lot of effort into something... They sweat and sometimes cry, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why not take her name into account? “Shizuku” means “droplets”, so we could add some to her shoulders and sleeves...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There. Whenever you turn, light's gonna reflect off all of these droplets and make you sparkle like crazy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, you're gonna look so cute!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Bullseye!>
<Seeing Shizuku in this would absolutely make me smile.>
<I wanna see you in this!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What do you think, Shizuku?
We sort of just ran with what we had but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I couldn't be happier.
Really...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much.
I feel like this design's already cast a spell on me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You guys should all wear these.>
<I wanna see you in these too!>
<It's a great design.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<And we got to pitch ideas for Shizuku's outfit.>
<I really want to see what kind of spell gets cast on MMJ!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This started out as a competition, but I kinda want to go with these outfits...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. These seem like the right choice for us. Not only that, we got to think of what Shizuku's outfit should look like with everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna wear the outfit Shizuku came up with too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had a feeling!
If it's alright with you, Shizuku, we'd like to go with your outfits... What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I vote yes!>
<Me too. This brings out the best in all of you.>
<I'd love to make these.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm not sure what else to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Congratulations, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
We're gonna be wearing these on stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
I can't wait to see how we look in them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, however...
I do need to ask you all something.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What's up?>
<Ask away!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... What if we didn't end things here just yet? What if we kept discussing ideas to make these outfits really special?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could include some of the ideas from Minori, Haruka and Airi's designs, while also hearing more from all of you like we did with my outfit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you have come up with some wonderful ideas that I never would've arrived at, so I don't want them to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to keep this discussion going. By doing so, I have a feeling that these outfits will become something even more wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Shizuku really cares about what we think.>
<Yeah, let's keep coming up with ideas!>
<I'll try thinking of some too!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like everyone's on board.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we set up a form that lets everyone who wants to contribute submit their ideas?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be great if they can cast some of their magic on us like they did with Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This all started with me wanting to feel the same magic I did when I put on that outfit as a member of Cheerful * Days...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But it's like everyone else was able to cast a spell on me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I promise to do everything I can to spread as much hope and magic as I can to our fans and everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to keep making these strides with them.)
